Say hello to our NEW Summer Edition, V7 Cream Soda is here!

V7 & V Cola
من مصر هدية لكل العالم

Forget the Pyramids, Egypt deserves an award for these clever hygiene lids! 🤫🥤🏆 

We are trying the local V7 drinks, 100% natural flavours and only 14 EGP (about 20p) a can! It feels like a luxury treat rather than a fizzy pop. 🍋🍇🍍

Today we've got these four, but there are so many more flavours on the high street. Diving into local brands saves so much money and gives you the best experience!

Sharing everyday finds like this is exactly why I’m writing my pocket guide on how to navigate shops and manage money like a local here. It’s all about family travel confidence! 

Which flavour would you try first? 👇
